description: issue #685 (slice I6): on_click is a visible command name under the interaction-events profile, so a well-formed pointer handler checks clean (spec/interaction-events.md's `### on_click <block>`). This locks the checker half of the two-halves requirement — on_click is registered in both PROFILE_STATEMENT_FORMS (so it parses) and collectVisibleNames (so the live unknownCommandRule gate does not reject it as ol-unknown-command). Together with on-click-rejected-core-only this proves the form end to end: profile active → checks clean; Core-only → rejected.
